summary: Imports are all used. Several generic declarations sit in topic-specific files, some hidden behind `private`: a sphere rescaling homeomorphism that already exists inline elsewhere, coefficient-change reflection lemmas, a compact-support colimit lemma, and homotopy-invariance lemmas for simple connectivity.
